decision_basis: Agent pre-results preparation allocation under delegated authority, not a claim of separate human recipe approval or empirical optimality. Keep all eleven languages from the qualified restricted-code scope; allocate most tokens to common application and systems languages while retaining smaller scripting/query/documentation components. Both pinned sources expose those languages. These token weights are a new explicit preparation prior, not a silent conversion of old tokenizer sample byte quotas. No code model outputs have been observed.
application: Apply identical weights independently to each source inside each code arm and code background; the equal blend is 50/50 within every language, not only in aggregate. Require per-language headroom. Surplus in another language cannot hide a deficit.
policy_boundary: Existing source-use approvals and source-specific file/repository license, attribution, English prose, security and exclusion obligations remain in force. Source-specific vendor/fork metadata availability differs and must remain disclosed in stock plans; common language weights alone do not imply identical source filters or independent ancestry.
change_rule: Record a successor before affected-category outputs; no post-result redistribution or dropping a language to pass capacity. Final whole-document quotas, alignment/lookahead, train/validation partition, order/seed and launch contracts remain pending.
